about_the_game:
Welcome. It’s your first night shift as a staff member at the Napolitan Hotel.

Your tasks at the hotel are very simple.

Your main duty is to complete the safety checklist placed on each floor.

If you notice any suspicious objects or items in the hallway, call the front desk to receive appropriate instructions.

However, there may be situations that the front desk cannot resolve.

For example:

  • The elevator you’re in suddenly moves to a floor you didn’t select.

  • The power system unexpectedly shuts down, turning off the hallway lights.

  • A strange sound gets closer and closer to you...

To prepare for such situations, make sure to familiarize yourself with the Staff-Only Safety Guidelines passed down by senior employee Steve.

Use all your senses to make it through the night shift safely.

If you do your job well, you may become the full-time hotel staff member you’ve always wanted to be.

Good luck.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports 60FPS or higher

short_description: A thrilling horror game where strange phenomena and mysterious entities disrupt your night shift. Can you finish your work and become a full-time employee?
